# Jaydip Vasoya

> Senior Full Stack Engineer (Python, Django, React, AWS · AI Agents and FinTech), based in Ahmedabad, India. Senior Full Stack Engineer with over 6 years of experience building FinTech platforms and production AI products. Recent work includes an LLM research agent on Claude and AWS Bedrock, a desktop AI assistant that reads and controls live trading charts through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, a real time voice AI assistant, and a market data pipeline that processes the US options (OPRA) firehose. Comfortable owning a product from architecture to production and working directly with clients.

## Experience
- Senior Full Stack FinTech and AI Engineer, Freelance (Jan 2025 to Present): Long term engineering partner for an options analytics company, delivering four connected products: a web analytics platform, a real time market data pipeline, a desktop AI app, and a voice AI assistant.
- Senior Software Engineer and Partner, LNX Cloud Technology (Jan 2020 to Jan 2025): Led the architecture and development of scalable cloud applications for clients in FinTech, SaaS, and social media.

## Key projects
- AI Options Analytics Platform: Core engineer on a subscription platform with four pricing tiers and 130+ analytics pages for options flow, dark pool, and volatility data, updated live over 100+ WebSocket routes. Stack: Django, DRF, Channels, Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS Bedrock, LangGraph, LangFuse, Stripe.
- Real Time Options Flow and Dark Pool Pipeline: A market data pipeline built to hold up under traffic bursts from the US options (OPRA) firehose and dark pool trades. Stack: Python, Redis Streams, RediSearch, WebSockets, Multithreading, AWS S3, PM2.
- AI Desktop Trading Assistant: A cross platform Electron app where an AI agent reads and controls live TradingView charts. Stack: Electron, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Anthropic SDK, AWS Bedrock, Gemini, MCP.
- Voice AI Trading Assistant: A browser based voice assistant with a live transcript, built on Django Channels. Stack: Python, Django Channels, Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, Gemini Live, ElevenLabs, Docker, Pytest.
